settings.bar_line_1: Apply to Become Our UGC Creators.
settings.bar_line_2: Earn Monthly Gift Cards & Exclusive Prizes

settings.about_body:
The Venustas Talents Program is our UGC creator recruitment project designed to bring together Venustas fans who love to share and connect. 

Join us, share your Venustas moments, and inspire others with your photos, videos, or stories. Every talents has the chance to earn gift cards, free gear, and exclusive perks. 

You don’t need to be a professional creator—just bring your passion, creativity, and love for sharing.dedication, and your commitment to others.

settings.step_text: Submit your application and wait for our reply!
You'll receive our reply in 7 days once your application is approved.
Welcome aboard! You can start creating your UGC now.
Share your contents and claim your monthly rewards!

settings.steps_disclaimer:
Remark: Please note that any content you share will be authorized for Venustas's promotional use. 
Your submissions may be selected for banners, advertisements, social media campaigns, and other marketing purposes.

settings.share_step_1: We welcome all types of UGC—including photos, videos, and blog posts.
settings.share_step_2: Once you receive our approval, you can start creating and sharing content on your social media or website.
settings.share_step_3: Please mention our brand name Venustas, use the hashtags #Venustas and #VenustasTalents, and tag our official account in every post.
settings.share_step_4: After posting, simply submit your content or screenshots through the “Claim Rewards” section below to receive your monthly rewards!"
settings.share_social_label: Here are our official social media accounts:

settings.community_subtitle:
Join our Facebook group to share the warmth and get inspired by the Venustas community. 
Get a chance to shine on our social channels!

settings.rewards_subtitle: Submit your content to earn monthly rewards and get a chance to win special prizes!
settings.reward_1_text:
Creators who submit UGC content will receive a $10-$20 Gift Card for 

Venustas.com.
settings.reward_2_text: Each month, top-performing creators will be selected as Venustas Talent Stars and rewarded with a best-selling heated vest or a $100 Gift Card for Venustas.com.

settings.faq_heading: How Do We Select Talent Stars?
settings.faq_body:
Selection is based on engagement rate, content quality, creativity and storytelling,
and affiliate performance (if applicable),
with final interpretation rights reserved by Venustas.

settings.cta_subheading: Apply today to become a Venustas UGC creator, or claim your rewards if you're already in the program.
